messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up to the fanout-compression RFC. Need a pragmatic default for ingress schema behavior before sprint.
Maya: Can someone list the options in one line?
Alex: 1) Strict gate (reject unknown attrs), 2) Lenient ingress + canonicalizer later, 3) Ingress compression: drop unknowns but attach tiny breadcrumb envelope.
Sanjay: Strict gate = predictable queries but will break older SDKs and needs coordinated rollout.
Irene: Lenient saves clients but we pay storage/ingest; we'll need compaction later.
Jess: Numbers? Rough prototype: lenient ~+18% storage/+12% CPU; ingress compression ~+6% storage/+4% CPU plus a small provenance cache.
Luke: Compression hurts lineage for chargeback. Can't always know who added an attr.
Sanjay: What if breadcrumb includes {origin, sdk_v, attr_hash, compat_v}? Small footprint but helps attribution.
Irene: How big is a breadcrumb?
Alex: ~120B avg. At 500M events/day that's ~60GB/day; we can TTL breadcrumbs to 7d and keep full lineage only for sampled events.
Jess: Hybrid sounds pragmatic: sampled full-lineage + lightweight breadcrumb for all.
Maya: Risks: queries needing full lineage for non-sampled events, and permanent loss if SDKs remove fields before canonicalizer runs.
Sanjay: Add compat_v header so canonicalizer knows how to transform older SDK payloads. That allows safe prune + rehydrate.
Alex: Proposed decision: default to option 3 (ingress compression) + breadcrumb envelope (origin,sdk_v,attr_hash,compat_v) + 7d TTL + tenant-configurable sampled full-lineage retention.
Irene: +1 if we publish an SDK migration playbook and a deprecation window for attr removals.
Luke: Also surface a "best-effort" chargeback mode that falls back to sampled lineage with a warning tag.
Jess: I'll update the RFC follow-up doc with cost numbers and fallback guidance.
Alex: Next steps: Jess updates doc, Infra builds TTL metadata tier, DevEx notifies SDK owners about compat header/deprecation window.
ops-bot: Reminder: /remind @eng-platform in 2 days to review the updated RFC. :calendar:
Maya: Thanks everyone, I'll coordinate the DevEx email.
Alex: Closing thread — decision will be landed in RFC and rollout tracked on sprint board.
